newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon plans Arab capital markets conference.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon plans Arab capital markets conference.

text.p: Some 300 participants are expected to take part in the third annual Arab Capital Markets conference in Beirut between May 21-23, the organisers said on Friday.
Arab ministers, central bank governors, heads of Arab and other financial and banking institutions, as well as private investors, businessmen and capital markets experts are expected to attend.
The conference is organised by Al Iktisad wal Amal magazine in cooperation with the Bank of Lebanon and the International Finance Corporation, the private sector arm of the World Bank.
Topics at the conference, which is being sponsored by Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri, will include:
-Economic reform and privatisation in the Arab world.
-Arab banking and financial industry in the coming century.
-The role of private sectors in financing infrastructure
-Investment opportunities in Egypt, Tunisia and Jordan.
The conference will also include a special workshop on investment opportunities in Lebanon and the country's program for economic development.
